entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, agent ID 304. How can I help you today?
I can certainly help you with that. To pull up your account, could I please get your order number?

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered six days ago on January 15th. To proceed, I just need to ask, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Preference. I just changed my mind.
I see. So to be clear, the device is working correctly, you just find you don't use it?
Yes. It was an impulse buy. I want to return it.
Alright, I understand. For situations like this, some customers find our VeloFit resale marketplace to be a good option. But let me first check the official return eligibility for your order.
Okay, looks like you're all set. Our policy allows for returns within 10 days of delivery, so you are unfortunately outside that window. I can process this for you right now.
Fine. Whatever. Just send me the shipping label.

Of course. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives the item, the refund will be issued to your original form of payment. Can I help with anything else?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
